start: AI Assistant open; the gym has past AI tasks

user_sees: A list, newest first: the words asked, then what it did, the day and time in India time, and a status
must_not: Tasks of another gym
A time in the phone time zone instead of India time
The ask box shown under History

user_sees: Other tasks say 'Not sent', 'Cancelled' or 'Did not work' with no credits
must_not: Credits shown on a task that was not sent or was cancelled
'1 credits'

user_sees: The 'Ask' tab opens with the same words in the box
must_not: The task run again by itself
A message sent or a credit taken by the tap

user_sees: A fresh bubble and a new card to check
must_not: The old result reused without asking again

user_sees: 'History could not load. Check the internet and try again.'
must_not: An endless Loading…
The empty words 'Nothing yet' when the list simply failed to load

steps.action: Turn the internet on, tap 'Ask' then 'History' again
must_not: The failed state kept after the internet is back

start: A new gym whose owner has never given the AI a task

user_sees: 'Nothing yet. Tasks you give the AI Assistant show here.'
must_not: A blank area
An error line

steps.action: Ask for a message, leave the draft unsent, open 'History'
user_sees: The request with status 'Not sent' and no credits
must_not: The unsent draft shown as 'Done'
A credit shown

steps.action: Send the draft from its card, open 'History' again
user_sees: The same request now 'Done · 1 credit', with a line such as 'Message: {title}'
must_not: Two rows for the one task
The row still saying 'Not sent'
A cancelled task shown with credits

start: Owner signed in; a staff login exists for the same gym

user_sees: Only this gym's requests, with member names as the owner typed them
must_not: Requests of another gym

steps.action: Sign in as staff or trainer and look for the AI Assistant
user_sees: No AI Assistant in the menu, no History
must_not: Staff reading what the owner asked the AI
History kept in the browser after the owner signs out

steps.action: Look for a task older than 400 days
must_not: Request words kept past 400 days
